name: Dondy
summary: WhatsApp marketing and support for Shopify on the official WhatsApp Business API: abandoned-cart recovery, campaigns to Shopify segments, automated order messages, a shared inbox and an AI chatbot for sales and support.
best_for: Shopify stores whose customers already live in WhatsApp (much of Europe, Latin America, the Middle East and Asia) that want cart recovery, order updates and campaigns on the official API without leaving the Shopify admin
skip_if: your customers are on email and SMS, or you need one predictable monthly figure: Meta's per-conversation charges sit on top of every paid tier here
honest_knock:
The free plan is a chat button. It is a decent chat button, and conversations through it are unlimited. But none of the marketing this app is named for is in it. Automated cart recovery, campaigns and the official API begin at $79.99 a month, and the $6.99 tier in between only lets you send those same messages by hand (500 a month, on the plan screen in the app on 17 November 2026).

You will also get two bills. Dondy charges the subscription; Meta charges per conversation on the WhatsApp Business API. Dondy can only tell you the rate starts at $0.0158 or $0.0126, because the real figure depends on the country you are messaging and the type of conversation. A thousand one click messages a month are included on Power Automation and Elite; past that, your monthly total is not knowable from this listing, and a campaign to a large segment is exactly the kind of thing that produces a surprise. Model it against your own list size and destination countries before you send one.

The rest is Meta's rulebook, not Dondy's. Opt-in, message templates and sender quality are governed on WhatsApp's side, so approval and reach are not things this app can promise you whatever you pay it. The review record is strong: 834 reviews on 17 November 2026, 92% at the top rating, and the 21 one star reports have not grown while 60 reviews were added since August, and a misfired broadcast on this channel is still a block rather than an unsubscribe.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per month for the chat button and messages you send by hand
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/dondy-marketing-ai, listed as “Dondy: WhatsApp Marketing+Chat”, and in our own test session on 17 November 2026) The listing shows four tiers, Free, Pro at $6.99 a month, Power Automation at $79.99 and Elite at $159.99, and the plan screen inside the app adds a fifth, Ultimate at $299 a month. Each paid listing tier has a 7 day free trial, and every listing amount is unchanged since 22 August 2026. Free: a WhatsApp chat button with unlimited conversations, custom size and location, and prefilled messages. Pro $6.99 a month or $67.10 a year, a 20% saving: premium button designs, a WhatsApp widget, text customisation, product URLs in messages, custom hours, reports, and abandoned-cart and order-confirmation messages you send manually. Power Automation $79.99 a month or $719.88 a year, a 25% saving: automated abandoned-cart recovery, WhatsApp marketing campaigns, customisable automated messages, bulk messaging to Shopify segments, an inbox with Shopify integration and the official WhatsApp Business API. It includes 1,000 one-click messages every 30 days and quotes WhatsApp rates starting at $0.0158 in the US on top. Elite $159.99 a month or $1,439.88 a year, also a 25% saving, adds an AI chatbot for sales and support, AI corrections and training, AI product recommendations, a five-agent WhatsApp inbox, green-tick verification assistance, a VIP account manager and unlimited WhatsApp flows; same 1,000 included messages, rates starting at $0.0126. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and Meta's per conversation charges are separate from all of it. The plan screen inside the app, in our own test session on 17 November 2026, showed the same amounts for Pro, Power Automation and Elite but described them differently: Pro with 500 manual WhatsApp messages a month and WhatsApp click analytics, Power Automation with a WhatsApp team inbox for 2 agents and a dedicated WhatsApp Business API phone number, and Elite with custom WhatsApp automation flows and a dedicated WhatsApp strategist. It added Ultimate at $299 a month, labelled All channels: an AI agent on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and email, double the AI replies of Elite, an Instagram and Facebook Messenger inbox, an email inbox with Gmail, custom automation flows and campaigns, and a dedicated account manager. Below the cards an Enterprise plan carried no price, only Talk to us on WhatsApp and Book a call. Every paid plan in the app offered a 7 day free trial; we did not check the app's annual prices. The Shopify approval screen for Pro asked for a payment method, so we did not approve it. The listing now also advertises work the dossier did not cover in August: collecting WhatsApp reviews through Judge.me, Loox, Yotpo, Trustoo or Google, cash-on-delivery messaging, and AI agents alongside the chatbot; the named integrations are Shopify Flow, Shopify Admin, Judge.me, Klaviyo, Loox, WhatsApp API and WhatsApp Business. Developer Dondy; the app launched 15 March 2023, is available in five languages and carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge. On 17 November 2026 the listing showed 834 reviews averaging 4.9, up from 823 on 18 September and 774 on 22 August, distributed 92% five star (767), 4% four star (36), 1% three star (6), 0% two star (4) and 3% one star (21). The one star count has stayed at 21 since August, so all 60 reviews added since then landed above the bottom.
